title: The D7.1 generation record has no field layout, no final-call set and no message text in the sources
source: Story RWB-E1-052 sections 4, 7, 11 and 12; FSD P7 v3 A2.10 and AC-P7-010-01; TSD P7 v2 T3.1; RWB-P6-E1052-CON
description: The legacy story fixes what a D7.1 generation entry must contain in substance (rule R-LIT-03, template code and version, the merge snapshot reference) but no source states where the template version, the ACE data date and the merge snapshot reference sit inside inputs_ref, actions and outcome, which final-call values a generation decision uses, or the text of MSG-P7-009. The record payload is therefore taken from RWB-P6-E1052-CON with the placement and the final-call set read as ASM-B2-P7-014-1 and ASM-B2-P7-014-4, and the MSG-P7-009 text is left to the message catalogue as ASM-B2-P7-014-6.
evidence: RWB-E1-052 section 4 step 7 and section 12 name the entry, the rule and the merge snapshot reference but no column; FSD P7 v3 AC-P7-010-01 names the entry, the decision code, the rule and the template version only; TSD P7 v2 T3.1 fixes inputs_ref, actions and outcome as text and jsonb containers with no content; MSG-P7-009 is named by FSD P7 v3 AC-EXC-P7-002-01 with no message text.
proposed: Fix the payload of the generation record in RWB-P6-E1052-CON and in Service Contract Catalog v1: template code and version and the merge snapshot reference in inputs_ref with the ACE data date on the entry, the notice reference and type in actions, the hold reason or refusal message and the freshness message in outcome, and the final-call set GENERATED, HELD and REFUSED as a reference list.

title: No source states which service appends the D7.1 generation record to the central ledger
source: Story RWB-E1-052 section 12; RWB-P6-E1052-APP section 1 and section 4 step 7; Architecture v5 slides 14, 28 and 41; Decision Log v10 (D-RCV-35, D-RCV-47)
description: The monolith wrote the generation entry in one process with the notice row. In the target RWB-P6-E1052-APP writes its own local D7.1 record through the decision-record library and publishes DecisionRecorded, while Architecture v5 gives the central ledger, the append-only rule and the chain to rwb-decision. No source states that this service appends the generation record of another service's decision, or which of the two writes is the record of record. This story is written as the ledger slice (ASM-B2-P7-014-5), with the two baselines of section 12.7 and none of the platform contracts in the H row (ASM-B2-P7-014-7).
evidence: RWB-E1-052 section 12 writes the entry through DecisionLogApi in the monolith and has no split; RWB-P6-E1052-APP states the local record and the publish; Architecture v5 slide 28 states that rwb-decision collects the records and seals the ledger, and slide 14 gives the ledger and its reads to rwb-decision; no document names the appender of a generation record per service.
proposed: Confirm in Service Contract Catalog v1 that rwb-decision appends every DecisionRecorded fact of every service to decision_log_entry, that the producer's local record is the working record and the ledger entry is the record of record, and that the platform contracts RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-TE006-CON, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON are wave-0 and wave-1 baseline and stay out of the H row.
